PLATE.gloss: base consisting of a rubber slab where the batter stands
PLATE.definition: (baseball) base consisting of a rubber slab where the batter stands; it must be touched by a base runner in order to score.
PLATE.example: He ruled that the runner failed to touch home.

PLEAT.gloss: any of various types of fold formed by doubling fabric back upon itself and then…
PLEAT.definition: Any of various types of fold formed by doubling fabric back upon itself and then pressing or stitching into shape.

PALE.definition: Very light colored; highly diluted with white.

PLEA.gloss: a humble request for help from someone in authority
PLEA.definition: A humble request for help from someone in authority.

LEAP.gloss: a light, self-propelled movement upwards or forwards
LEAP.definition: A light, self-propelled movement upwards or forwards.

PEAT.gloss: partially carbonized vegetable matter saturated with water
PEAT.definition: Partially carbonized vegetable matter saturated with water; can be used as a fuel when dried.

LET.gloss: make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen
LET.definition: Make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen.
LET.example: This permits the water to rush in.

LATE.gloss: being or occurring at an advanced period of time or after a usual or expected time
LATE.definition: Being or occurring at an advanced period of time or after a usual or expected time.

PET.definition: A domesticated animal kept for companionship or amusement.

TAPE.gloss: a long thin piece of cloth or paper as used for binding or fastening
TAPE.definition: A long thin piece of cloth or paper as used for binding or fastening.

TALE.gloss: a message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events
TALE.definition: A message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events; presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program.

LAP.definition: Lie partly over or alongside of something or of one another.
